preview: Today, we look at a planned phone service for users of Meta’s AI assistant. It raises a question about trust when an AI acts for you. By the end, you will understand what this example tells us about knowing how an AI service really works.
comment_1: Listen for what the AI phone service was meant to do.
comment_2: The idea was to have AI make a phone call for you. But what was really happening behind this planned feature?
comment_3: Meta was preparing a service that would let its AI make phone calls for users. The AI was called Muse. Now listen for what people found when they looked more closely.
comment_4: The service looked like AI, but the work behind it was not always done by AI alone. Now, let’s bring the main point together.
